rationale: Comfort lighting (MAINTAIN/discomfort/occupied) vs safety lighting (GUARD/harm/night) pursue different outcomes and failure interpretations.
Whole-home cleanliness (scheduled/unoccupied) is broader than floor cleanliness (threshold_event); not mutually substitutable outcomes.
Home cleaning vs clean laundry are distinct maintained outcomes despite shared trigger; neither covers the other.
Shutter closure for security vs lights-off for energy differ in beneficiary, outcome, and failure mode.
Time-bound morning medication achievement (ACHIEVE_BY) vs general ongoing adherence support (MAINTAIN); lifecycle and outcome framing differ.
PREPARE_FOR cooking readiness (heat+light+oven) vs MAINTAIN kitchen lighting comfort are distinct outcomes from same rule.
